She has long white pigtails and elongated elf ears. She smiles brightly and waves at the camera with her right hand while slightly swaying her body in a playful manner. (2) The scene transitions to a different woman cosplaying as Fern, featuring long purple hair and a heavy black cloak over a white dress. She raises one arm high above her head and then brings both hands together at her chest, smiling softly towards the viewer. Production equipment is visible behind her. (3) The first woman in the Frieren costume returns to the frame, performing a 'shush' gesture with a single finger to her lips before pointing her hand to the side. She wears black sheer tights and tan boots. The lighting is bright, natural, and consistent throughout the shots. (4) A third woman cosplaying as Übel appears, with bright green hair styled in a side ponytail and a black strappy dress. She waves briefly and then points a finger forward with a confident and mischievous expression. A man in a dark suit is visible in the far background. (5) The final phase shows all four women gathered together in a group pose. A fourth woman with pink hair and horns cosplaying as Aura is positioned in the foreground. They all perform a synchronized cute pose with their hands framing their faces in a cheerful display.
